rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something excessively showy or attention-seeking.

example.english: Their wedding stage is so gaudy that it steals everyone's attention.
example.traditional: 佢個婚禮舞台整到咁浮誇，搶晒所有人鏡。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 fan1 lai5 mou5 toi4 zing2 dou2 gam3 fau4 kwaa1 coeng2 saai3 so2 jau5 jan4 geng3

rows.note: Use this for something brightly coloured or covered in conspicuous decorative details, especially clothes or décor.

example.english: Isn't your shirt a bit too gaudy for going for dim sum?
example.traditional: 你件恤衫花哩花碌咁，去飲茶會唔會太誇張呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 gin6 seot1 saam1 faa1 li1 faa1 luk1 gam3 heoi3 jam2 caa4 wui5 m4 wui5 taai3 kwaa1 zoeng1 aa3

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is that the gaudy style looks tacky or lacking in taste rather than merely eye-catching.

example.english: The room is covered in rhinestone curtains; it looks gaudy and tacky.
example.traditional: 間屋掛滿閃石窗簾，睇落又老土又浮誇。
example.jyutping: gaan1 uk1 gwaa3 mun5 sim2 sek6 coeng1 lim2 tai2 lok6 jau6 lou5 tou2 jau6 fau4 kwaa1
